title: Modal Adopts Nvidia Vera CPUs for 2x AI Agent Throughput
summary:
The hosting platform Modal will add Nvidia hardware to its server fleets to accelerate the execution of autonomous AI agents. The startup is deploying Vera processors alongside existing Intel and AMD chips after internal tests showed a 2x increase in throughput for agent hosting compared to those incumbent CPUs.

Nvidia's Vera engineering team stated that agent workloads are shifting CPU demand toward single-thread speed rather than high core counts. To support this, the chip utilizes a single compute die and custom LPDDR5X memory to reduce latency when transferring work back to GPUs.
